categories.intro: Сложная идея за 20–90 секунд: метафора, схема, пошаговый разбор. Лучше всего делаются в Claude Motion или кодом (Remotion, HyperFrames): текст, схемы, иконки.

items.title: Сложное через простую метафору
items.prompt:
Make a 45-second animated explainer of [CONCEPT] for [AUDIENCE] using one metaphor: [CONCEPT] is like [EVERYDAY THING].
Open with a hook question in big type in the first 2 seconds: "[HOOK QUESTION]?".
Act 1 (0–10s): show the everyday thing with simple flat shapes and label each part.
Act 2 (10–35s): morph each part of the metaphor into the matching part of [CONCEPT], one at a time, with a short caption per step.
Act 3 (35–45s): pull back to show the whole system working, then a one-line takeaway: "[TAKEAWAY]".
Style: flat 2D, two colours plus one accent ([ACCENT COLOUR]), rounded shapes, soft easing, no stock icons.

items.title: Как это работает: процесс по шагам
items.prompt:
Animate how [PROCESS] works in [N] steps for [AUDIENCE].
Each step gets its own beat of about 5 seconds: a numbered label slides in, a simple diagram builds itself, and an arrow carries the result into the next step.
Keep one persistent object (a dot, a document, a package) travelling through every step so the viewer can follow it.
End on the full pipeline visible at once, with the object arriving at "[FINAL RESULT]".
Clean white background, thin 2px lines, one brand colour [HEX], monospaced labels, ease-in-out on every move.

items.title: «Было → стало»
items.prompt:
A 20-second before/after explainer. Split the frame vertically.
Left side, labelled "Before": [OLD WAY], shown as a cluttered, slow, grey animation (things piling up, a clock ticking, a progress bar stalling).
Right side, labelled "After": [NEW WAY], the same task done in colour, fast and tidy, finishing first.
At 15 seconds the divider slides left and the "After" side takes the whole frame, with the line "[RESULT, e.g. 3 hours → 10 minutes]".
Bold sans-serif type, high contrast, snappy cuts.

items.title: Разбор научной статьи
items.prompt:
Turn this paper into a 75-second animated explainer for a smart non-expert: [PASTE ABSTRACT OR LINK].
Structure: the question (why it matters) → what people believed before → the method in one diagram → the key result as an animated chart → one limitation → what it changes.
Show the main number from the paper large and let it count up.
Use a calm editorial look: off-white paper texture, serif headings, sans-serif labels, ink-blue accent, gentle camera drift.
Put a small citation in the corner of every scene.

items.title: Термин за 15 секунд
items.prompt:
A 15-second vertical "word of the day" clip that defines [TERM].
0–3s: the term types itself in huge letters, with the pronunciation underneath.
3–10s: a one-sentence definition appears word by word while a tiny animated example plays above it.
10–15s: "Example: [EXAMPLE SENTENCE]" and a series logo "[SERIES NAME] #[NUMBER]".
Make it work as a series template: keep the layout fixed, only text and the example change.

items.title: Почему это происходит
items.prompt:
Answer "Why [EVERYDAY PHENOMENON]?" in a 40-second vertical explainer.
Start with the phenomenon as a simple looping illustration and the question in bold.
Zoom in three levels (everyday scale → small scale → tiny scale), each with a one-line caption explaining what happens there.
Zoom back out and replay the opening loop, now with labels showing the cause.
Bright, friendly palette, chunky outlines, playful bounce easing, captions centred in the safe area.

items.title: Сравнение двух вариантов
items.prompt:
A 30-second comparison of [OPTION A] vs [OPTION B] for [AUDIENCE].
Two cards face each other like opponents. For each of [N] criteria ([CRITERION 1], [CRITERION 2], [CRITERION 3]) a row appears and a meter fills on each side.
Keep it fair: show where each one wins.
Finish with "Pick [A] if… / Pick [B] if…" side by side.
Neutral dark background, A in [COLOUR A], B in [COLOUR B], scoreboard-style numbers.

items.title: Ошибка, которую делают все
items.prompt:
A 30-second vertical clip: "The [TOPIC] mistake almost everyone makes".
Hook: the mistake shown as a quick animation that ends with a big red cross.
Then: why it happens (one diagram), what to do instead (three short animated steps), and the result compared side by side.
Close with "Save this for later" and a bookmark icon that pops.
High-contrast black and yellow, heavy condensed type, cuts on every sentence.

items.title: Объяснение кода/алгоритма
items.prompt:
Animate how [ALGORITHM / CODE CONCEPT] works, for junior developers.
Left half: the code ([LANGUAGE], max 12 lines), with the current line highlighted as it runs.
Right half: the data structure it changes ([ARRAY / TREE / QUEUE]), animated step by step in sync with the highlighted line.
Run one small example ([INPUT]) all the way to the output ([OUTPUT]).
End with the Big-O written large and a one-line intuition.
Dark editor theme, monospace font, cyan highlight, smooth 300ms transitions.

items.title: Миф или правда
items.prompt:
A 25-second vertical "Myth or fact?" clip about [TOPIC].
Show the claim "[CLAIM]" on a card. A stamp hovers between MYTH and FACT for 2 seconds of suspense, then slams down on [ANSWER].
Explain why in three quick animated captions with one simple illustration each.
Finish with the true statement and "Follow for more myths".
Stamp-and-paper look, kraft background, red and green ink, slight paper shake on the stamp.

items.title: Путь пользователя
items.prompt:
Animate the journey of [PERSONA] through [PRODUCT / SERVICE / PROCESS], from [START] to [GOAL].
A small character walks along a winding path; each stop is a touchpoint ([STEP 1], [STEP 2], [STEP 3], [STEP 4]) with a mood emoji that shows how they feel there.
Highlight the pain point at [STEP] in red and the fix in green.
End with an overview map of the whole path.
Isometric flat illustration, pastel palette, gentle camera follow.

items.title: Цифры, которые трудно представить
items.prompt:
Make [BIG NUMBER / SCALE, e.g. "a billion seconds"] feel real in 40 seconds.
Start with something countable (one dot = [UNIT]). Keep zooming out and multiplying the dots, comparing them to familiar things at each step ([COMPARISON 1], [COMPARISON 2], [COMPARISON 3]).
Show a counter in the corner the whole time.
End with the full number spelled out and one surprising line: "[PUNCHLINE]".
Black background, white dots, one warm accent colour, slow, deliberate zooms.

categories.intro: Ролики для лендинга, X/Twitter, Product Hunt и магазинов приложений: интерфейс, фичи, логотип в финале. Делаются в Claude Motion или кодом; скриншоты и брендбук прикладывайте к промпту.

items.title: Запуск SaaS за 30 секунд
items.prompt:
A 30-second launch video for [PRODUCT], a [ONE-LINE DESCRIPTION] for [AUDIENCE].
0–5s: the problem in one bold line: "[PROBLEM]".
5–22s: three features, about 5 seconds each: [FEATURE 1], [FEATURE 2], [FEATURE 3]. Rebuild each as a clean UI card (not a screenshot) that animates the action a user would take.
22–30s: the logo assembles on the beat, then the URL "[URL]" and "[CTA]".
Brand colours [HEX 1] and [HEX 2], font [FONT], cuts synced to a 120 BPM track.

items.title: Одна фигура — весь интерфейс
items.prompt:
A 20-second product film where one shape morphs continuously into every key UI element of [PRODUCT]: a button, then [ELEMENT 2], [ELEMENT 3], [ELEMENT 4], and finally the logo.
A cursor drives every change, clicking, dragging and scrolling.
Never cut: one continuous take.
Black and white only, with a single accent colour on the final logo. Spring easing with a slight overshoot.

items.title: Тизер новой функции
items.prompt:
A 15-second teaser for [FEATURE NAME], coming to [PRODUCT] on [DATE].
Show only glimpses: blurred UI fragments, a cropped close-up of [KEY ELEMENT], a cursor hovering but never clicking.
Text beats: "Something new" → "[HINT]" → the date revealed with a mask wipe.
Dark background, glowing edges, low hum building to a hit at the date.
Export both 9:16 and 16:9.

items.title: Промо приложения для App Store
items.prompt:
A 25-second App Store preview for [APP NAME] ([CATEGORY]).
A phone mockup sits centre frame; the screen walks through [SCREEN 1] → [SCREEN 2] → [SCREEN 3] with real taps and swipes (show touch ripples).
Above the phone, one short benefit line per screen: "[BENEFIT 1]", "[BENEFIT 2]", "[BENEFIT 3]".
No text in the last 3 seconds, just the app icon growing.
Background: soft gradient in [BRAND COLOURS].

items.title: Продукт из одной точки
items.prompt:
Product reveal for [PRODUCT]: a single dot on a black screen pulses, then grows lines that become [MAIN CHART / MAIN SCREEN].
Panels unfold around it one by one ([PANEL 1], [PANEL 2], [PANEL 3]) until the full dashboard is built.
Final move: the camera pulls back fast until the dashboard is a star in space, then the logo.
Neon-on-black, thin lines, subtle glow, deep bass hits on each panel.

items.title: Чейнджлог → видео релиза
items.prompt:
Turn this changelog into a 30-second release video: [PASTE CHANGELOG].
Pick the 3–4 most user-visible changes. For each: a version tag, a short headline, and a small animated UI demo of the change.
Open with "[PRODUCT] v[VERSION]" and close with "Update now" + [URL].
Developer aesthetic: dark theme, monospace accents, terminal cursor blink transitions, green highlights.

items.title: Продукт за один непрерывный кадр
items.prompt:
A launch film for [PRODUCT] in one continuous take: photos, UI and type flow into each other with no cuts.
Start with [INPUT, e.g. a photo / a messy note], which slides into the app, gets transformed by [KEY ACTION], and comes out as [OUTPUT].
Each transformation is a match move (the shape of one thing becomes the next).
Warm off-white canvas, soft shadows, rounded corners, calm piano.

items.title: Product Hunt: «Мы запустились!»
items.prompt:
A 20-second square "We're live on Product Hunt" clip for [PRODUCT].
Open with confetti bursting from the logo, then the tagline "[TAGLINE]".
Show three tiny looping feature demos in a row.
Finish with an upvote arrow that bounces, the text "Support us today" and [LINK].
Bright, celebratory, [BRAND COLOUR] with orange accents, bouncy easing.

items.title: Демо в стиле «напиши → получи»
items.prompt:
A 12-second square product sting for [AI PRODUCT].
A user types "[EXAMPLE PROMPT]" into an input field (realistic typing speed, a few corrections).
On enter, the answer [PAGE / IMAGE / TABLE] builds itself block by block.
Two feature cards stack in from the bottom: "[FEATURE 1]" and "[FEATURE 2]".
End on the logo. Light UI, rounded cards, subtle depth.

items.title: Сравнение тарифов
items.prompt:
Animate how our pricing plans compare for [OCCASION, e.g. the sales kickoff].
Plans: [PLAN 1 – PRICE – KEY FEATURES], [PLAN 2 – …], [PLAN 3 – …].
Cards rise one by one; features tick in as checkmarks; the recommended plan lifts higher and glows.
End with "[CTA]".
Corporate but friendly: white cards, brand colour [HEX], subtle shadows.

items.title: Запуск в бумажном стиле
items.prompt:
A 15-second launch film for [PRODUCT] in a light paper style.
UI cards are cut-out paper pieces with torn edges and soft drop shadows; they slide, fold and stack as if moved by hand (slight stop-motion jitter at 12 fps).
Three beats: "[PROBLEM]" → "[SOLUTION]" → logo stamped like a rubber stamp.
Cream paper, pencil-line details, one ink colour.

items.title: Ролик-милестоун
items.prompt:
Celebrate [MILESTONE, e.g. 1,000,000 users] for [PRODUCT] in 15 seconds.
A counter ticks up from 0 with accelerating speed while a growth chart draws itself behind it.
At the target number, the counter freezes, the digits explode into particles that reform as "Thank you".
Finish with the logo.
Gold-on-black, sparkles on the peak, a drum roll that ends on a hit.

categories.intro: Короткая реклама товаров и услуг: проблема → решение → призыв. Часть шаблонов — для видеогенераторов (Veo, Sora, Kling, Seedance, Runway), часть — для анимации (Claude Motion).

items.title: Проблема → решение → CTA (15 с)
items.prompt:
A 15-second vertical ad for [PRODUCT].
0–3s hook: "[PAINFUL QUESTION]?" in huge type, shaking slightly.
3–9s: the pain, shown as 2 quick animated scenes ([PAIN 1], [PAIN 2]).
9–13s: [PRODUCT] appears and fixes it; show the result as a number or a happy visual.
13–15s: "[OFFER]" + "[CTA]" button that pulses.
Captions always on, safe area respected, brand colour [HEX].

items.title: UGC-отзыв «как будто снято на телефон»
items.prompt:
Handheld vertical selfie video, shot on a phone. A [AGE]-year-old [PERSON DESCRIPTION] sits in [PLACE, e.g. their car / kitchen], natural window light, slightly messy background.
They hold up [PRODUCT] to the camera and say, enthusiastic but casual: "[LINE, max 20 words]".
Small natural camera shake, quick glance away and back, authentic smile.
Audio: their voice only, room tone, no music.

items.title: Товар на столе: «распаковка»
items.prompt:
Top-down shot of a wooden table. Two hands open a [PACKAGING] and lift out [PRODUCT], turning it slowly to catch the light.
Soft daylight from the left, shallow depth of field, crisp detail on [KEY DETAIL].
Satisfying sounds: paper rustle, box lid, a soft click.
Camera: static, then a slow push-in on the product in the last 2 seconds.

items.title: Продуктовый «герой-кадр»
items.prompt:
Premium commercial hero shot of [PRODUCT] on [SURFACE: wet black stone / marble / sand].
[ELEMENT: water splash / falling petals / slow smoke] moves around it in slow motion (120 fps look).
Camera: slow 180° orbit at product height, macro lens, f/2.8.
Lighting: dark studio, rim light in [COLOUR], one soft key from above.
No text, no people. Ends on a clean frame with space on the right for a logo.

items.title: Еда: аппетитный крупный план
items.prompt:
Macro close-up of [DISH], freshly made. [ACTION: cheese stretching / syrup pouring / steam rising / a knife slicing through].
Warm tungsten light, dark background, shallow depth of field, slow motion.
Camera slowly pushes in. Rich sizzling and pouring sounds.
Style: high-end food commercial.

items.title: Акция / распродажа
items.prompt:
A 10-second promo for [STORE]'s [SALE NAME].
The discount "-[N]%" smashes into frame, cracks the screen, and product cards ([PRODUCT 1], [PRODUCT 2], [PRODUCT 3]) fly through the cracks with old prices crossed out.
A countdown "Ends [DATE]" ticks in the corner.
Final card: "[PROMO CODE]" + "[CTA]".
Loud, bold, red and yellow, beat-synced hits.

items.title: Отзывы клиентов каруселью
items.prompt:
A 20-second social-proof video for [BUSINESS].
Five review cards (name, star rating, one sentence) slide in one after another, each staying 3 seconds: [REVIEW 1] … [REVIEW 5].
Stars fill one by one; the rating total counts up to "[AVERAGE] ★ from [N] reviews".
End with the logo and "[CTA]".
Clean white cards on a soft [BRAND COLOUR] background.

items.title: Местный бизнес: «зайдите к нам»
items.prompt:
Cosy cinematic shot inside [BUSINESS TYPE: a small coffee shop / bakery / barbershop] at [TIME OF DAY].
[ACTION: a barista pours latte art / bread comes out of the oven / a stylist finishes a cut] in the foreground; a few customers chat softly in the blurred background.
Warm golden light, slight film grain, slow dolly-in.
Natural ambient sound, gentle acoustic guitar.

items.title: Реклама в стиле гравюры
items.prompt:
A 20-second brand ad for [BRAND] in the style of an old engraving: crosshatched black ink on aged paper.
The illustration of [PRODUCT / SYMBOL] draws itself line by line, then the lines begin to move (gears turn, steam rises, leaves sway).
Ornamental frame and Victorian-style type: "[HEADLINE]".
Final beat: a wax seal stamps the logo.

items.title: Сериал из трёх коротких реклам
items.prompt:
Make three 6-second bumper ads for [PRODUCT] that work as a series.
Each one: a single relatable situation ([SITUATION 1], [SITUATION 2], [SITUATION 3]) in 4 seconds, then the same end card "[TAGLINE]" + logo.
Same layout, font and end card across all three, a different accent colour per ad.
No voice-over; captions carry the joke.

items.title: Анти-реклама (самоирония)
items.prompt:
A 20-second "honest ad" for [PRODUCT] that pokes fun at itself.
Classic ad clichés appear (a lens flare, "revolutionary!", a stock-photo smile) and are crossed out one by one by a hand-drawn red pen.
Then plain honest lines: "[HONEST LINE 1]", "[HONEST LINE 2]", "It just [WHAT IT DOES]."
End: logo + "[CTA]". Deadpan timing, white background, black type, red marker.

items.title: Продукт в руке — реалистичный демо-кадр
items.prompt:
Close-up POV shot: a hand holds [PRODUCT] and demonstrates [ONE ACTION] in [SETTING].
Show the result clearly: [RESULT].
Bright natural daylight, realistic skin and reflections, handheld micro-movements.
Keep the product shape and logo consistent with the reference image [ATTACH IMAGE].
Ambient sound of the room plus the product's own sound.

categories.intro: Вертикальные 9:16, 7–60 секунд. Главное — крючок в первые 2 секунды и субтитры. Шаблоны форматов, которые хорошо смотрятся сериями.

items.title: Топ-5
items.prompt:
A 30-second vertical countdown: "Top 5 [TOPIC]".
Hook (0–2s): "#1 will surprise you" over a blurred preview of #1.
Each item gets 5 seconds: a big rank number flips in, the name, one visual, one fact.
Progress dots at the top show where we are.
End: "Which one did you know? 👇".
Energetic, bold numbers, colour changes per item, whoosh on each transition.

items.title: «POV:» ситуация
items.prompt:
First-person POV vertical video: you are [ROLE] at [PLACE] when [SITUATION].
Camera at eye level, natural head movement, hands visible at the bottom of the frame.
[WHAT HAPPENS in 2–3 beats].
Realistic lighting, ambient sound.
On-screen caption at the top: "POV: [CAPTION]".

items.title: Факт, который взрывает мозг
items.prompt:
A 15-second vertical clip with one mind-blowing fact about [TOPIC]: "[FACT]".
Reveal the fact in three parts so each line raises curiosity.
Illustrate it with one simple, looping animation.
Make the last frame match the first so the video loops seamlessly.
Dark background, glowing type, one sound hit per line.

items.title: Мини-туториал «3 шага»
items.prompt:
A 25-second vertical tutorial: "How to [RESULT] in 3 steps".
Show the final result for 2 seconds first, then rewind effect.
Steps 1–3: big step number, a short instruction, an animated demo of the action.
End: the result again + "Save for later".
Clean, bright, big captions in the middle third, tick sound on each step.

items.title: Сторителлинг «я сделал X за Y дней»
items.prompt:
A 40-second vertical story: "I tried [CHALLENGE] for [N] days".
Day counter in the corner advances fast; progress bar fills.
Highlights: Day 1 ([FEELING]), Day [X] ([PROBLEM]), Day [Y] ([BREAKTHROUGH]), Day [N] ([RESULT]).
Each highlight is a 6-second card with a doodle illustration.
End with the before/after and "Would you try it?".
Notebook / diary aesthetic, handwritten font, marker highlights.

items.title: Вопрос → ответ (для комментариев)
items.prompt:
A 20-second vertical "reply to comment" video.
Show a comment bubble from @[USERNAME]: "[QUESTION]".
The bubble flies to the top, and the answer builds below in 3 animated points with tiny icons.
End: "Ask the next question in the comments".
Social-app look: rounded bubbles, system font, soft shadows.

items.title: Ожидание vs реальность
items.prompt:
A 12-second vertical split-screen: top half "Expectation", bottom half "Reality", about [TOPIC].
Top: [IDEAL VERSION], polished, glossy, slow motion.
Bottom: [REAL VERSION], chaotic, funny, plays at the same time.
At 9 seconds the top half glitches and collapses into the bottom one.
Labels in bold white with black outline.

items.title: Залипательный луп
items.prompt:
An 8-second perfectly seamless loop that is oddly satisfying: [OBJECTS, e.g. coloured balls] [ACTION, e.g. drop into slots, sort themselves by colour, and reset].
Physics should feel weighty and exact. The last frame must equal the first.
Pastel colours, soft shadows, top-down view, satisfying click sounds.

items.title: Таймлапс «из ничего в готовое»
items.prompt:
Timelapse vertical video: [EMPTY THING, e.g. an empty room / bare plot / blank canvas] transforms into [FINISHED THING] over 8 seconds.
Static camera on a tripod, light changes from morning to evening across the clip.
Workers / brush strokes / growth appear as fast motion blur.
Final second holds on the finished result.

items.title: Тренд-шаблон «вещи, которые…»
items.prompt:
A 20-second vertical list: "Things only [GROUP OF PEOPLE] understand".
Six quick items, 3 seconds each, each with a tiny looping illustration and one line of text.
Each card slides up like a story.
End with "Tag someone who…".
Playful sticker style, thick outlines, bright flat colours.

items.title: Хук-заставка для начала ролика
items.prompt:
Design a 3-second hook intro for my vertical videos about [NICHE].
The hook line "[HOOK]" slams in word by word with screen shake; a short whoosh-hit sound.
Leave the bottom third empty so it can be layered over talking-head footage.
Transparent background (export with alpha), white type with black stroke, [ACCENT] highlight on the key word.

items.title: Субтитры «как у блогеров»
items.prompt:
Add word-by-word animated captions to my talking-head video [FILE].
Transcribe with timestamps, show 1–3 words at a time in the centre-lower third.
The current word pops (scale 1.15) and turns [ACCENT COLOUR]; key words get an emoji.
Font: heavy rounded sans, white with black stroke and soft shadow.
Also cut silences longer than 0.4 s and add a subtle zoom-in on punchlines.

categories.intro: Ролики, где главный герой — текст: цитаты, манифесты, лирик-видео, титры. Идеально для Claude Motion и кода.

items.title: Цитата крупным шрифтом
items.prompt:
A 15-second kinetic typography piece for the quote: "[QUOTE]" — [AUTHOR].
Words arrive in rhythm with natural speech; the 2–3 key words are larger and in [ACCENT COLOUR].
Use scale, weight and position changes rather than fades. Each line clears with a sharp mask wipe.
Hold the full quote for the last 3 seconds, then the author name.
Black background, white grotesque type, no other elements.

items.title: Манифест бренда
items.prompt:
A 45-second manifesto film for [BRAND] made only of type.
Text: [PASTE MANIFESTO, 6–10 short lines].
Each line gets its own treatment: one stretches, one stacks, one is cut by a moving bar, one fills the whole frame letter by letter.
Build tension towards the final line, then silence and the logo.
Two colours only: [COLOUR 1] and [COLOUR 2], swapping background/foreground on key lines.

items.title: Лирик-видео под трек
items.prompt:
Make a lyric video for [SONG FILE] with these lyrics: [PASTE LYRICS].
Detect beats and align every line to its timestamp; words appear exactly when sung.
Verses: calm, small type, lower third. Chorus: huge full-screen type that pulses on the kick.
Change the colour palette at each new section. Background: slow abstract gradient reacting to volume.

items.title: Хромовая типографика на бит
items.prompt:
A 15-second showreel of loud kinetic typography in chrome and black.
Words: [WORD 1], [WORD 2], [WORD 3], [WORD 4], [BRAND].
Every word lands on a beat with a hard cut, metallic reflections sliding across the letters.
Mix extreme scales: one letter fills the screen, the next word is tiny in the corner.
Final: the brand name in chrome with a light sweep.

items.title: Швейцарский стиль
items.prompt:
A 15-second Swiss-style motion piece about [SUBJECT].
Strict 12-column grid visible as faint lines; red (#E30613) and black on white.
Helvetica-like type moves only along grid lines; blocks slide and snap.
Use numbers and arrows as graphic elements. Ends with a perfectly balanced poster frame.

items.title: Слово меняет смысл
items.prompt:
A 10-second typographic animation where the word "[WORD 1]" morphs letter by letter into "[WORD 2]", and then into "[WORD 3]", telling a tiny story ([e.g. "dream" → "draft" → "done"]).
Letters that stay move smoothly to new positions; letters that change flip like a split-flap display.
Centred, large serif, cream background, dark ink.

items.title: Титры фильма
items.prompt:
An opening title sequence for a film called "[TITLE]", genre: [GENRE].
Credits ([NAMES AND ROLES]) appear one by one, integrated with abstract imagery that hints at the story ([MOTIF]).
Pacing: slow and moody; each credit holds ~3 seconds.
Typography in [STYLE, e.g. condensed serif], letterboxed 2.39:1, film grain, the title last and largest.

items.title: Текст набирается в терминале
items.prompt:
A 20-second terminal animation. A prompt "$" blinks, then types: [COMMANDS / MESSAGE].
Output lines stream fast after each command, with realistic delays.
At the end the screen clears and ASCII art of "[NAME / LOGO]" draws itself line by line.
Green-on-black CRT look with scanlines and slight glow.

items.title: Цифры и статистика типографикой
items.prompt:
A 20-second vertical typographic piece built around 4 numbers about [TOPIC]: [NUMBER 1 – meaning], [NUMBER 2 – …], [NUMBER 3 – …], [NUMBER 4 – …].
Each number counts up huge, then shrinks to the top as its meaning types under it.
End with all four arranged as a poster.
Bold condensed sans, [COLOUR] on off-white.

items.title: Поэма, проявляющаяся строками
items.prompt:
Animate this short poem: [PASTE POEM].
Each line becomes legible slowly, as if ink soaks into paper; previous lines dim but stay.
Gentle camera drift; one small illustrated motif ([MOTIF]) grows in the margin as the poem progresses.
Paper texture, serif type, muted palette, calm ambient pad.

items.title: Типографика из реальных предметов
items.prompt:
Cinematic macro shot: the word "[WORD]" is formed by [MATERIAL, e.g. flowing honey / stacked books / neon tubes / sand] on [SURFACE].
The letters assemble themselves over 4 seconds, then the camera slowly pulls back.
Photorealistic, studio lighting, shallow depth of field. The spelling must be exactly "[WORD]".

items.title: Глитч-заголовок
items.prompt:
A 5-second glitch title for "[TITLE]".
The headline splits into RGB channels, slices displace horizontally, scanline noise flickers, then it snaps back clean.
Repeat the glitch twice briefly, the second time revealing a subtitle "[SUBTITLE]".
Black background, cobalt and vermilion channel offsets, digital crackle sound.

categories.intro: Оживить цифры: квартальный отчёт, гонка графиков, карта, инфографика. Прикладывайте таблицу (CSV/Excel) — Claude построит графики из реальных данных.

items.title: Квартальный отчёт за 30 секунд
items.prompt:
Turn our Q[N] report into a 30-second explainer for the all-hands. [ATTACH REPORT / DATA].
Pick the 4 most important numbers. For each: the metric name, the number counting up, the change vs last quarter with a green/red arrow, and one sentence of context.
Open with "Q[N] in 30 seconds", close with "What's next: [PRIORITY]".
Company colours [HEX], clean charts, no 3D.

items.title: Гонка графиков (bar chart race)
items.prompt:
Make a bar chart race from [DATA FILE / DATA DESCRIPTION]: [ENTITIES] by [METRIC] from [YEAR START] to [YEAR END].
Bars reorder smoothly, each with a logo or flag and a value label; a big year counter in the bottom right.
Annotate 2–3 key moments with short captions ("[EVENT]").
Hold the final ranking for 3 seconds.
Readable at phone size: max 10 bars, thick labels.

items.title: График, который рисуется сам
items.prompt:
Add motion to this chart for the board deck: [ATTACH CHART / DATA].
The axes draw first, then the line draws left to right while a dot rides its tip and a value label updates.
At [POINT OF INTEREST] the line pauses, a callout appears: "[ANNOTATION]".
Finish with the final value highlighted. Minimal, corporate, brand colour [HEX].

items.title: Карта с маршрутом / распространением
items.prompt:
An animated map showing [WHAT: our expansion / a trip / the spread of something] across [REGION].
Start zoomed on [START LOCATION]; lines arc to [LOCATION 2], [LOCATION 3], [LOCATION 4] in order, with dates appearing next to each.
Cities pulse when reached; a counter tracks [METRIC].
Flat muted map, bright accent lines, smooth camera pans between points.

items.title: Инфографика «один человек из 100»
items.prompt:
Show [STATISTIC, e.g. "If the world were 100 people…"] as a 10×10 grid of tiny person icons.
For each fact ([FACT 1 – N%], [FACT 2 – N%], [FACT 3 – N%]), the matching number of icons changes colour and a caption appears.
Reset between facts with a quick ripple.
Clean flat icons, warm palette, calm music.

items.title: Дашборд оживает
items.prompt:
A 20-second animation of a [COMPANY] dashboard coming alive.
Tiles drop in on a grid: [KPI 1], [KPI 2], [KPI 3], a line chart, a donut chart, a table.
Numbers tick up, charts draw, a live dot pulses on "Real-time".
Camera slowly glides across the dashboard at a slight 3D angle, then flattens to front view.
Dark mode UI, neon accents.

items.title: Год в цифрах
items.prompt:
"[YEAR] in numbers" for [COMPANY / TEAM / PERSONAL].
8 numbers, one per beat: [NUMBER – LABEL] × 8. Each with a matching mini-animation (a plane for trips, a coffee cup for coffees, etc.).
Accelerate pacing towards the end, finish with "Thank you / See you in [NEXT YEAR]".
Festive but clean: dark navy, gold accents, confetti at the end.

items.title: Сравнение долей (пирог → столбцы)
items.prompt:
Show how [BUDGET / TIME / MARKET] is split: [CATEGORY – %] × 4–5.
Start as a donut chart that fills segment by segment with labels, then morph the segments into a ranked bar chart so the differences are easier to compare.
Final: highlight [CATEGORY] with a callout "[INSIGHT]".

items.title: Временная шкала (таймлайн)
items.prompt:
An animated timeline of [SUBJECT] from [START] to [END].
A horizontal line draws itself; the camera tracks along it.
Milestones ([DATE – EVENT] × 6–8) pop up above/below alternately, each with a small icon or image.
Speed up through quiet periods, slow down on the big ones.
End with "Today" and a glowing dot.

items.title: Воронка продаж
items.prompt:
Animate our sales funnel: [STAGE 1 – N], [STAGE 2 – N], [STAGE 3 – N], [STAGE 4 – N].
Particles pour into the top and fall through; at each stage some drop off to the side, and the conversion % appears.
Highlight the biggest drop-off in red: "[INSIGHT]".
Clean isometric funnel, brand colours.

items.title: Данные о погоде/природе как арт
items.prompt:
Turn [DATASET, e.g. daily temperatures in [CITY] over 50 years] into a 30-second generative data-art animation.
Each data point becomes a [stripe / ring / particle] coloured on a blue-to-red scale.
The piece builds over time; the year counter shows in small type.
End with a single sentence about what the pattern shows.
Minimal, gallery-like, black background.

items.title: Отчёт инвесторам
items.prompt:
A 60-second investor update video for [STARTUP], [MONTH].
Sections: headline metric (big number + MoM growth), revenue chart, key wins (3 bullets with icons), challenges (1–2, honest), asks ("We're looking for: [ASK]").
Calm confident pace, clean charts, founder photo optional in the intro.
Brand colours [HEX], subtle background music.

categories.intro: Короткие 3–10-секундные ролики: появление логотипа, интро канала, аутро, переходы.

items.title: Медленная сборка логотипа
items.prompt:
An impressive 8-second slow-reveal motion design that assembles and finally reveals the [BRAND] logo [ATTACH SVG].
Start with abstract fragments of the logo's shapes drifting in darkness; they find each other, align and lock with satisfying precision.
Last 2 seconds: light sweep across the finished logo, then the tagline "[TAGLINE]" fades in.

items.title: Логотип из частиц
items.prompt:
A 6-second logo reveal: thousands of tiny particles swirl like a galaxy, then are pulled into the shape of the [BRAND] logo [ATTACH SVG].
Once formed, the logo glows briefly and the particles settle into solid fill.
Dark background, particles in [BRAND COLOUR], deep whoosh into a soft hit.

items.title: Интро YouTube-канала
items.prompt:
A 5-second YouTube intro for the channel "[CHANNEL NAME]" about [TOPIC].
Quick montage of 4 animated icons representing the topic ([ICON 1], [ICON 2], [ICON 3], [ICON 4]), each on a beat, then the channel name slams in with a sticker-like bounce.
Bright, punchy, [COLOUR] palette. Leave sound slots for a 4-beat jingle.

items.title: Аутро с подпиской
items.prompt:
A 15-second YouTube end screen for [CHANNEL].
Left: two empty rounded rectangles for recommended videos (placeholder frames). Right: a circle for the subscribe button with the avatar.
Background: slow looping animation in channel colours [HEX].
Text: "Thanks for watching" fades in at the top. Everything settles by second 2 and stays still.

items.title: Стикер-штамп логотипа
items.prompt:
A 3-second logo sting: the [BRAND] logo is stamped onto the screen like a rubber stamp — slight ink spread, a tiny bounce, a thud sound.
Use as an end card for social videos. Transparent background, export with alpha.

items.title: Логотип из жидкости
items.prompt:
Photorealistic macro shot: glossy [LIQUID: ink / paint / molten gold] flows across a dark surface, swirls, and settles into the exact shape of the logo in the reference image [ATTACH LOGO].
Slow motion, studio lighting with soft reflections, camera slowly rising to a top-down view by the end.
Keep the logo geometry exact.

items.title: Переход-шторка для видео
items.prompt:
Make a pack of 6 one-second transitions in my brand colours ([HEX 1], [HEX 2], [HEX 3]): diagonal wipe, circle iris, stacked bars, liquid blob, pixel dissolve, shape zoom.
Each must fully cover the frame at the midpoint (frame 12 of 24) so I can cut underneath.
Export with alpha.

items.title: Лоуэр-тёрд (подпись спикера)
items.prompt:
An animated lower third for interviews: name "[NAME]" and title "[TITLE]".
A thin accent line draws from the left, the name slides up from behind it, then the title fades in smaller.
Holds 3 seconds, then animates out in reverse.
Clean sans-serif, white text on a semi-transparent dark bar, accent [HEX]. Export with alpha.

items.title: Интро подкаста
items.prompt:
A 10-second intro for the podcast "[PODCAST NAME]" with hosts [HOST NAMES].
An audio waveform grows from the centre and reacts to the jingle [ATTACH AUDIO]; host avatars pop up on the left and right.
The show name forms from the waveform peaks. Episode number "[EP #]" in the corner.
Warm retro radio vibe: orange and cream, rounded type.

items.title: Заставка мероприятия
items.prompt:
A 15-second stage opener for [EVENT NAME] [YEAR] at [VENUE].
A giant countdown 10 → 0, each number built from a different abstract shape in event colours.
At zero, everything explodes into the event logo and the theme line "[THEME]".
Designed for an LED wall (high contrast, no fine details), loud hits on each number.

items.title: Логотип в стиле 3D-глины
items.prompt:
Claymation-style 3D shot: lumps of colourful plasticine roll onto a pastel table and squish themselves into the [BRAND] logo [ATTACH LOGO].
Visible fingerprints in the clay, stop-motion frame rate (12 fps), soft daylight.
Final pose holds for 1 second with a tiny happy bounce.

items.title: Неоновая вывеска
items.prompt:
The [BRAND] logo as a neon sign on a dark brick wall at night.
It flickers on tube by tube with electric buzz, one letter stutters, then all stay lit with a soft glow on the wall and a reflection in a wet pavement below.
Colours: [NEON COLOURS]. Slight camera drift.

categories.intro: Уроки, история за минуту, математика и физика, «как устроено». Хорошо работают сериями.

items.title: История за 60 секунд
items.prompt:
The history of [SUBJECT] in 60 seconds.
Five eras, 12 seconds each: [ERA 1], [ERA 2], [ERA 3], [ERA 4], [ERA 5].
Each era has its own visual style that matches the period (cave painting → manuscript → engraving → poster → digital), with the date large and one key event illustrated.
A thin timeline at the bottom fills up as we go.
End: "And now: [TODAY]".

items.title: Математика рисует себя
items.prompt:
Visually prove/explain [MATH IDEA, e.g. why the sum of angles in a triangle is 180°] in 30 seconds.
Shapes draw themselves with chalk-like strokes; pieces move, rotate and rearrange to make the idea obvious without words.
Show the formula only at the end, building term by term.
Dark slate background, chalk-white lines, one yellow highlight, Manim-like smooth motion.

items.title: Физика на доске
items.prompt:
Explain [PHYSICS CONCEPT] on an animated whiteboard.
A hand-drawn diagram ([SETUP]) comes alive: objects move with correct physics, force arrows appear and change length in real time, a graph of [QUANTITY] vs time plots alongside.
Short handwritten captions appear next to each phase.
White board, blue and red markers, slight marker squeak sounds.

items.title: Путешествие частицы
items.prompt:
Follow [A PHOTON / A DROP OF WATER / A RED BLOOD CELL / A DATA PACKET] on its journey from [START] to [END].
Camera stays locked on it; the world around it changes scale and scenery at each stage ([STAGE 1], [STAGE 2], [STAGE 3]).
A distance/time counter in the corner.
End where it arrives: "[FINAL FACT]".
Cinematic, glowing particle, rich backgrounds.

items.title: Урок-слайд с анимацией
items.prompt:
An animated lesson for [GRADE / AGE] on [TOPIC].
Structure: hook question → 3 key ideas, each with a simple animated illustration → a quick quiz question with a 3-second pause → the answer → a one-line summary.
Friendly, clear, large text; never more than 12 words on screen at once.
Classroom-poster style: bright flat colours, rounded shapes.

items.title: Как устроено изнутри
items.prompt:
Show how [DEVICE / MACHINE, e.g. a mechanical watch / an electric car / a toilet] works inside.
Start with the object whole; it separates into an exploded view, parts labelled.
Then reassemble and run it, highlighting the flow of [ENERGY / WATER / FORCE] through the parts in colour.
Technical-illustration style: blueprint lines, isometric view, smooth rotations.

items.title: Язык: слово в контексте
items.prompt:
A 20-second vertical lesson for learners of [LANGUAGE]: the word "[WORD]".
Show the word, transcription and translation; then 3 example sentences, each illustrated with a tiny animated scene, and the key word highlighted.
Finish with a mini-quiz: "How would you say: [PHRASE]?" and the answer after 3 seconds.
Cheerful flat style, consistent template for a series.

items.title: Один день из жизни в прошлом
items.prompt:
Scene [N] of 6 of "A day in the life of a [PERSON] in [PLACE], [YEAR]".
[SCENE DESCRIPTION: e.g. dawn, the baker lights the clay oven in a narrow stone street].
Historically accurate clothing, architecture and tools; natural light of the period (candles, fire, daylight).
Camera: slow handheld documentary style. Ambient sounds of the era, no music.
Keep the main character consistent: [CHARACTER DESCRIPTION].

items.title: Рекурсия/идея во всех стилях
items.prompt:
Explain [CONCEPT] five times in 30 seconds, each time in a different visual style: hand-drawn sketch, Swiss poster, 8-bit pixel art, blueprint, and claymation.
The explanation is the same; only the style changes, with a quick wipe between them.
Label each style in the corner.

items.title: Жизненный цикл
items.prompt:
Animate the life cycle of [ORGANISM / PROCESS, e.g. a butterfly / water / a star] as a seamless loop.
Stages arranged in a circle: [STAGE 1] → [STAGE 2] → [STAGE 3] → [STAGE 4]; the camera rotates around the circle as each one transforms into the next.
Small labels, natural palette, soft lighting. The loop restarts invisibly.

items.title: Что происходит за одну секунду
items.prompt:
"What happens on Earth in one second?"
A large 1-second timer is frozen while facts appear one by one: [N] babies born, [N] emails sent, [N] lightning strikes, [N] searches, [your own facts].
Each fact has a mini animated icon swarm of the right density.
At the end the timer finally ticks: 0.00 → 1.00.

items.title: Шпаргалка-экзамен
items.prompt:
A 45-second revision video for [EXAM / TOPIC]: the 7 things you must remember.
Each item: a big number, a keyword, a one-line rule, and a memorable visual hook (mnemonic).
Recap screen at the end shows all 7 as a cheat sheet to screenshot.
Notebook grid paper look, highlighter colours.

categories.intro: Персонажи, короткие сюжеты, сказки, скетчи. Для стабильного героя держите одно описание внешности и вставляйте его дословно в каждый промпт (см. плагин `cartoon-reel`).

items.title: Мини-мультик с двумя героями
items.prompt:
Shot [N] of [TOTAL]. Style: [STYLE, e.g. 3D Pixar-like / flat 2D / claymation], consistent across all shots.
Characters: [HERO: one-line appearance], [SIDEKICK: one-line appearance].
Setting: [PLACE].
Action: [WHAT HAPPENS in this shot].
Dialogue: [CHARACTER]: "[LINE, max 12 words]".
Camera: [wide / medium / close-up], [static / slow push-in].
Mood: [MOOD]. Keep faces, colours and proportions identical to previous shots.

items.title: Немое кино: смотритель маяка
items.prompt:
A 60-second silent short film with no dialogue: [CHARACTER] who [SITUATION, e.g. keeps a lighthouse alone] and [SMALL EVENT that changes their day].
Tell it in 6 scenes through action and expression only: routine → disruption → attempt → failure → small kindness → new routine.
Muted palette with one warm colour that grows across the film. Piano score, ambient sounds.

items.title: Сказка на ночь
items.prompt:
A 90-second bedtime story for [AGE]-year-olds about [CHARACTER] who [GOAL].
Picture-book style: watercolour textures, soft edges, pages that turn between scenes.
8 scenes, each with one sentence of narration (calm, warm voice).
Gentle ending where the character falls asleep; the last frame dims to a starry sky.

items.title: Скетч-комедия в офисе
items.prompt:
Three-shot comedy sketch set in an office.
Shot 1: [CHARACTER A] confidently explains [IDEA] to [CHARACTER B] at a whiteboard.
Shot 2: [UNEXPECTED THING HAPPENS].
Shot 3: reaction close-up on [CHARACTER B] — deadpan stare into camera, 2 seconds of silence.
Realistic sitcom lighting, handheld mockumentary camera.

items.title: Ожившие рисунки из скетчбука
items.prompt:
Top-down shot of an open sketchbook with pencil drawings of [ANIMALS / CHARACTERS].
One by one they come alive: they blink, stretch, and step off the page onto the desk, staying pencil-drawn.
[ONE OF THEM] pushes the pencil and draws a door; they all walk through it.
Natural desk lighting, paper texture, gentle music box melody.

items.title: Ретро-мультфильм 80-х
items.prompt:
A 30-second opening of an 80s Saturday-morning space cartoon called "[TITLE]".
Cel-animation look: thick outlines, limited animation, painted backgrounds, VHS colour bleed and slight tracking noise.
Heroes [TEAM] pose one by one with name cards; a big ship launches; the title zooms in with a starburst.
Synth theme song energy, 4:3 frame.

items.title: Театр теней
items.prompt:
Tell [STORY / FABLE] as a shadow-puppet play.
Black silhouettes of jointed paper puppets move against a warm orange backlit screen; slight flicker of a candle light source.
Scenery pieces slide in from the sides. Narrator voice-over, one line per scene.
Final scene: the puppeteer's hands appear briefly, then the light goes out.

items.title: Пластилиновый клип
items.prompt:
Claymation stop-motion shot (12 fps): a plasticine [CHARACTER] [ACTION, e.g. plays a tiny guitar on a rooftop] in a handmade miniature [SETTING].
Visible fingerprints and imperfections, felt and cardboard props, warm practical lights.
Camera: slow dolly sideways, like a real miniature set.

items.title: Пиксель-арт история
items.prompt:
A 30-second pixel-art story in the style of a 16-bit adventure game: [HERO] [QUEST in one line].
Side-scrolling scenes, dialogue boxes with typewriter text, chiptune music, HP bar in the corner.
Three scenes: setup → obstacle → victory with a "LEVEL COMPLETE" banner.
Limited 32-colour palette, crisp pixels, no smoothing.

items.title: История от лица предмета
items.prompt:
The life of [OBJECT, e.g. an old umbrella / a coffee mug / a bicycle] told from its point of view in 40 seconds.
Five moments with five owners or uses over the years: [MOMENT 1] … [MOMENT 5].
First-person narration as the object ("I was bought on a rainy Tuesday…").
Each moment in a slightly different colour grade showing the passing years.

items.title: Персонаж-маскот бренда
items.prompt:
Brand mascot shot: [MASCOT: one-line appearance, e.g. a round orange cube with tiny legs and big eyes] in [SETTING].
It [ACTION, e.g. waves, trips over a cable, gets up proudly] and points to the empty space on the right for a logo.
Style: [3D toy-like / flat vector], soft studio light, bright pastel background.
Expressive face, bouncy animation, short cute vocal sound.

items.title: Сериал «маленький робот»
items.prompt:
Episode beat: a small rusty robot with one antenna and round blue eyes [ACTION, e.g. tries to water a single flower growing through cracked concrete] in [SETTING, e.g. an abandoned city at sunset].
Cinematic, warm backlight, dust particles, shallow depth of field.
No dialogue, only small beeps and the wind.
Keep the robot's design identical in every episode.

categories.intro: Шаблоны для Veo, Sora, Kling, Seedance, Runway, Luma, Hailuo. Формула: **объект + действие + место + камера + свет + стиль + звук.** Один кадр — одна мысль, 5–10 секунд.

items.title: Универсальная формула кадра
items.prompt:
[SHOT TYPE: wide / medium / close-up / extreme close-up] of [SUBJECT with 2–3 visual details] [ACTION] in [LOCATION], [TIME OF DAY / WEATHER].
Camera: [MOVE: static / slow dolly-in / tracking / orbit / crane up / handheld], [LENS: 24mm / 50mm / 85mm], [DEPTH OF FIELD].
Lighting: [KEY LIGHT], [COLOUR PALETTE].
Style: [FILM LOOK, e.g. 35mm film, Kodak Portra, anamorphic].
Audio: [AMBIENT SOUNDS], [MUSIC or none], [DIALOGUE in quotes if any].

items.title: Эпичный пейзаж с дрона
items.prompt:
Aerial drone shot flying low over [LANDSCAPE: fjord / desert dunes / rice terraces / volcanic coast] at [golden hour / blue hour], then rising slowly to reveal [REVEAL: a lone tower / the ocean / a city].
Volumetric light, mist in the valleys, ultra-detailed, smooth gimbal motion.
Sound: wind and distant birds, swelling orchestral note at the reveal.

items.title: Трейлер: героический кадр
items.prompt:
Low-angle slow-motion shot of [CHARACTER: appearance, costume] walking towards camera through [ENVIRONMENT: smoke / rain / falling ash], [ACTION: drawing a sword / taking off a helmet].
Backlit by [LIGHT SOURCE], rim light on the silhouette, anamorphic lens flare.
Letterboxed 2.39:1, teal-and-orange grade, deep trailer boom on the last step.

items.title: Нуар в дождь
items.prompt:
Black-and-white film-noir shot: a detective in a trench coat lights a cigarette under a streetlamp on a rain-soaked street at night, [YEAR]-era city.
Hard side light through venetian blinds shadow pattern on the wall, reflections in puddles, steam from a grate.
Camera: slow push-in from medium to close-up. Sound: rain, distant jazz saxophone, the lighter click.

items.title: Киберпанк-город
items.prompt:
Tracking shot following [CHARACTER] through a dense cyberpunk market at night: holographic signs in [LANGUAGE], steam, crowds with umbrellas, flying vehicles overhead.
Neon magenta and cyan reflections on wet asphalt, shallow depth of field, slight handheld.
Sound: rain on umbrellas, chatter, synth bass hum.

items.title: Природа: макро
items.prompt:
Extreme macro nature documentary shot: [SUBJECT: a dew drop on a spider web / a bee landing on lavender / a snail on moss] at sunrise.
Razor-thin depth of field, soft bokeh, natural light, ultra-sharp detail.
Camera barely moves (slow focus pull from background to subject).
Sound: quiet morning forest ambience.

items.title: Ностальгия на плёнку
items.prompt:
Super 8 home-movie footage from [DECADE]: [SCENE: kids running through a sprinkler / a family picnic / a road trip in an old car].
Warm faded colours, heavy grain, light leaks, slight gate weave and flicker, 4:3 frame with rounded corners.
Handheld, a bit overexposed. Sound: projector whir, muffled laughter.

items.title: Сюрреализм
items.prompt:
Surreal dreamlike shot: [IMPOSSIBLE SCENE, e.g. a whale swims slowly through clouds above a quiet village / a staircase descends into the ocean / a room fills with floating oranges].
Calm, matter-of-fact atmosphere, pastel palette, soft diffuse light, like a Magritte painting come to life.
Slow steady camera, no cuts. Sound: soft ambient pad and distant bells.

items.title: Пролёт сквозь объекты (FPV)
items.prompt:
One continuous FPV drone shot: start outside [BUILDING / PLACE], fly through an open window, weave through [ROOMS / CROWD / KITCHEN], dive through [GAP] and burst out into [FINAL VIEW].
Fast, smooth, close to surfaces, motion blur, no cuts.
Bright realistic lighting. Sound: drone buzz and environment noises changing with each space.

items.title: Модный фэшн-кадр
items.prompt:
High-fashion editorial video: a model in [OUTFIT with details] walks towards camera on [LOCATION: a salt flat / brutalist rooftop / empty runway], wind moving the fabric.
Camera: slow-motion, 85mm, tracking backwards at eye level.
Lighting: [hard midday sun with deep shadows / soft overcast]. Colour grade: [STYLE].
Sound: minimal techno beat.

items.title: Изображение → видео (оживить фото)
items.prompt:
[ATTACH IMAGE]. Animate this image subtly and realistically.
Motion: [WHAT MOVES: hair and clothes in a light breeze / clouds drift / water ripples / the person turns their head and smiles].
Camera: [slow push-in / gentle parallax / static].
Keep the face, composition and colours exactly as in the image; no new objects.

items.title: Первый и последний кадр (переход)
items.prompt:
Start frame: [ATTACH IMAGE A]. End frame: [ATTACH IMAGE B].
Create a smooth, physically plausible transition between them: [HOW: the camera flies forward through / the object transforms / day turns into night].
Keep everything that exists in both frames stable; no flicker.

items.title: Многокадровая сцена с диалогом
items.prompt:
A short scene in [N] shots, consistent characters and lighting.
Characters: [A: appearance, voice], [B: appearance, voice]. Location: [PLACE], [TIME].
Shot 1 (wide, 3s): [ESTABLISHING ACTION].
Shot 2 (over-the-shoulder on A, 4s): A says "[LINE]".
Shot 3 (close-up on B, 4s): B reacts and says "[LINE]".
Shot 4 (wide, 3s): [ENDING ACTION].
Style: [FILM LOOK]. Ambient sound: [SOUNDS]. No music.

categories.intro: Клипы, визуализаторы, обложки-анимации (Spotify Canvas), фоны для диджей-сетов.

items.title: Аудиовизуализатор под трек
items.prompt:
Build an audio-reactive visualizer for [TRACK FILE].
Analyse the audio: kick drives a central shape's scale, hi-hats spawn small particles, bass moves a slow background gradient.
In the centre: the cover art [ATTACH COVER] in a circle that rotates slowly.
Artist name and track title in the lower third. Colours taken from the cover.

items.title: Spotify Canvas (луп 8 с)
items.prompt:
An 8-second seamless vertical loop for Spotify Canvas, based on the cover art [ATTACH COVER] of "[TRACK]" by [ARTIST].
Subtle motion only: [WHAT MOVES, e.g. the sky drifts, hair moves, light flickers].
No text, no hard cuts. Leave the lower third calm (the app overlays UI there). The last frame must match the first.

items.title: Клип из одного промпта
items.prompt:
Make a full music video for [TRACK FILE] entirely in code.
Split the song into sections (intro, verses, chorus, bridge, outro) by energy; give each section its own visual world built from [THEME].
Cuts land on downbeats; the chorus brings the biggest, brightest visuals; the bridge strips everything back to one element.
Lyrics optional as kinetic type: [LYRICS].

items.title: Пластилиновый музыкальный клип
items.prompt:
A 30-second claymation-style music video for [TRACK].
Plasticine characters [DESCRIPTION] play instruments in a tiny handmade room; objects squash and bounce on every beat.
Stop-motion frame rate (12 fps), visible fingerprints, warm practical lighting, bright colours.

items.title: Машина, которая играет музыку
items.prompt:
A Rube Goldberg-style machine that plays [MELODY / TRACK]: marbles roll down rails and hit xylophone bars, drums and bells exactly on the notes.
Generate the MIDI timing first, then build the track layout so physics matches the music.
Clean 3D, wood and brass materials, camera following the marbles.

items.title: Фон для диджей-сета
items.prompt:
A 60-second seamless VJ loop for a [GENRE] DJ set.
Abstract geometry in [COLOURS]: tunnels, strobing grids, morphing polygons; tempo [BPM] BPM with visual hits every 4 beats.
High contrast, no fine text, works on LED walls. Export as a looping MP4.

items.title: Анонс релиза
items.prompt:
A 15-second release announcement for "[TRACK / ALBUM]" by [ARTIST], out [DATE] on all platforms.
The cover art [ATTACH] assembles from shards, a 5-second preview of the track plays, the date flips like an airport board.
Platform icons line up at the bottom. Colours sampled from the cover.

items.title: Визуал «вода и звук»
items.prompt:
Macro shot of a shallow dish of water on a speaker, forming intricate cymatic patterns that change with a deep bass tone.
Dark background, a single coloured light reflecting in the water ([COLOUR]), crisp detail, slow motion.
Sound: the bass tone sweeping slowly up in pitch.

items.title: Сингл в стиле лоу-фай
items.prompt:
A cozy lo-fi loop: [CHARACTER] studying at a desk by a window at night, rain on the glass, a cat sleeping on the books, desk lamp glow.
Only small movements: pen writing, steam from tea, rain, cat breathing.
Anime-inspired painted style, warm and purple tones. Seamless 10-second loop.

items.title: Концертный хайлайт
items.prompt:
Shot from the crowd at a [GENRE] concert: the artist on stage [ACTION, e.g. jumps as the beat drops], confetti cannons fire, phone lights in the air.
Handheld, slight shake, lens flares from stage lights, hazy atmosphere.
Sound: roaring crowd and a heavy drop.

categories.intro: Видео о себе, приглашения, поздравления, итоги года, путешествия.

items.title: Видео-резюме для рекрутера
items.prompt:
A 20-second motion self-introduction for recruiters.
Name: [NAME]. Role: [ROLE]. 3 skills: [SKILL 1], [SKILL 2], [SKILL 3]. 2 achievements with numbers: [ACHIEVEMENT 1], [ACHIEVEMENT 2].
End with a contact card: [EMAIL] · [LINKEDIN].
Confident, clean, modern; my photo [ATTACH] in a circle at the start.

items.title: Портфолио-шоурил
items.prompt:
A 30-second showreel of my work: [ATTACH 6–10 IMAGES / PROJECT LINKS].
Each project gets 2–3 seconds with a smart transition that matches shapes or colours between projects.
Opening card: "[NAME] — [DISCIPLINE]". Closing: "[WEBSITE]".
Cut to an upbeat track at 110 BPM, project names small in the corner.

items.title: Приглашение на свадьбу/праздник
items.prompt:
A 20-second animated invitation to [EVENT: our wedding / birthday / housewarming].
[NAMES] invite you on [DATE] at [TIME], [VENUE, address].
Elegant style: [STYLE, e.g. watercolour florals / gold foil / minimalist]. Botanical illustrations grow along the edges, text appears with handwriting animation.
End: "RSVP by [DATE]: [CONTACT]" and a small map pin.

items.title: Поздравление с днём рождения
items.prompt:
A 15-second birthday greeting for [NAME], who loves [HOBBY / THING].
Their favourite thing becomes the decoration: [e.g. cats carry the cake, a guitar plays "Happy birthday"].
Candles count their age "[AGE]", then blow out and become confetti.
Message: "[PERSONAL MESSAGE]". Bright, cheerful, silly.

items.title: Итоги года (личные)
items.prompt:
My [YEAR] in 45 seconds. Month by month, one highlight each: [JAN – …], [FEB – …], … [DEC – …].
Each month is a photo [ATTACH] in a polaroid frame with a handwritten caption, flipping like a calendar.
Finish with "Best part: [THING]" and "Hello, [NEXT YEAR]".
Warm film-photo look, pastel tape, soft acoustic music.

items.title: Карта путешествия
items.prompt:
An animated travel map of my trip: [CITY 1] → [CITY 2] → [CITY 3] → [CITY 4], [DATES].
A small plane / car / train icon travels along a dotted route; at each stop a photo [ATTACH] pops up as a postcard with the city name and a stamp.
Total distance counter at the end: "[N] km, [N] days".
Vintage paper map style.

items.title: Объявление о рождении/помолвке
items.prompt:
A 15-second announcement: "[NEWS]".
Soft and tender: an envelope opens, a card slides out, details appear ([NAME], [DATE], [WEIGHT / RING / PHOTO]).
Pastel palette, gentle sparkles, lullaby-like music.

items.title: Трибьют / «спасибо» команде или учителю
items.prompt:
A 40-second thank-you video for [PERSON / TEAM] from [WHO].
Collage of photos [ATTACH] that drift slowly with Ken Burns motion; short quotes from people appear between them ([QUOTE 1], [QUOTE 2], [QUOTE 3]).
End: "Thank you, [NAME]" in large warm type.
Soft piano, warm colour grade.

items.title: Обратный отсчёт до события
items.prompt:
A template for a daily countdown story: "[N] days until [EVENT]".
The number is huge and made of [THEMED OBJECTS], it shatters into the next number at the end.
Keep the layout identical so I can generate one per day by changing only N.

items.title: Видео-открытка с праздником
items.prompt:
A 15-second greeting card for [HOLIDAY] from [SENDER].
A small [SEASONAL SCENE: snowy village / spring garden / lantern-lit street] comes alive: lights turn on one by one, [ANIMATION].
Message appears in handwritten type: "[MESSAGE]".
Cozy, magical, soft bells.

categories.intro: То, для чего Anthropic и придумали Claude Motion: объяснить свою работу — отчёт, план, онбординг, обучение сотрудников. Прикладывайте документы — Claude соберёт ролик из них.

items.title: Онбординг новых клиентов
items.prompt:
A product walkthrough for onboarding new customers of [PRODUCT]. [ATTACH SCREENSHOTS / DOCS].
Show the first 4 things a new customer should do: [STEP 1], [STEP 2], [STEP 3], [STEP 4].
For each: an animated cursor performs the action on a clean UI mock, with a short caption and step number.
End with "Need help? [SUPPORT LINK]". Friendly, calm pace, brand colours.

items.title: Стратегия компании за минуту
items.prompt:
Explain our [YEAR] strategy in 60 seconds for the all-hands. [ATTACH STRATEGY DOC].
Structure: where we are (one number) → where we're going (the goal) → 3 bets that get us there → what it means for each team.
Visual metaphor: a path up a mountain with 3 camps (the bets).
Inspiring but clear, brand colours.

items.title: Новый сотрудник: первый день
items.prompt:
A welcome video for new hires at [COMPANY].
"Welcome, [NAME]!" → our mission in one line → 3 values as animated icons ([VALUE 1], [VALUE 2], [VALUE 3]) → what happens in week one (timeline) → who to ask ([BUDDY]).
Warm, human, illustrated people of different backgrounds.

items.title: Объяснение процесса/регламента
items.prompt:
Explain our [PROCESS: expense reimbursement / incident response / code review] in 40 seconds. [ATTACH POLICY].
Show it as a flowchart that builds step by step, with who is responsible at each step (role icons) and the time limit.
Highlight the 1 most common mistake in red.
End with "Questions? → [CHANNEL]".

items.title: Обучение безопасности
items.prompt:
A 45-second security awareness clip: how to spot a phishing email.
An email appears on screen; a magnifying glass highlights 5 red flags one by one ([SENDER], [URGENCY], [LINK], [ATTACHMENT], [GREETING]).
Then "What to do": report it with [BUTTON / CHANNEL].
Calm, not scary; flat illustration style.

items.title: Кейс клиента
items.prompt:
A 45-second customer case study: how [CLIENT] used [PRODUCT] to [RESULT].
Challenge → solution → results (3 big numbers with count-up) → a quote from [PERSON, ROLE].
Client logo at the start, our logo at the end.
Professional, clean, charts drawn in brand colours.

items.title: Продажи: «зачем вам это»
items.prompt:
A 30-second sales video for [TARGET CUSTOMER] about why [PRODUCT] earns its place.
Show the cost of the problem (time/money counter running up), then the product stopping the counter, then the ROI: "[N]x return in [PERIOD]".
End with "Book a demo: [LINK]".

items.title: Питч стартапа
items.prompt:
A 60-second animated pitch for [STARTUP].
Problem (with a striking stat) → solution (product in one visual) → market size (TAM/SAM/SOM as nested circles) → traction (chart) → team (photos) → the ask ("Raising [AMOUNT]").
Confident pacing, one idea per scene.

items.title: Обновление роадмапа
items.prompt:
Animate our product roadmap for [PERIOD]: Now: [ITEMS], Next: [ITEMS], Later: [ITEMS].
Three columns; cards slide in; items that shipped since last update get a "Shipped ✓" stamp.
Clean kanban look, brand colours.

items.title: Объяснение договора/условий простыми словами
items.prompt:
Explain the key terms of [DOCUMENT: our subscription terms / rental agreement] in plain language. [ATTACH DOCUMENT].
Pick the 5 things a customer must know (price, cancellation, refunds, data, obligations) and show each as a card with an icon and one plain sentence.
Friendly, trustworthy, no legalese.

items.title: Отчёт об инциденте (постмортем)
items.prompt:
A 45-second blameless postmortem summary of [INCIDENT]. [ATTACH POSTMORTEM].
Timeline of the incident (detection → mitigation → resolution) on a horizontal bar with timestamps.
Root cause as a simple diagram, impact as numbers, and 3 action items with owners.
Calm, factual tone; neutral palette with red only for the outage window.

items.title: Анонс внутреннего события
items.prompt:
A 15-second announcement for [EVENT: hackathon / offsite / demo day] on [DATE].
Energetic: the event name builds from pixel blocks, the date and place appear, three things to expect pop as stickers ([THING 1], [THING 2], [THING 3]).
"Sign up: [LINK]". Playful, bright, internal-brand colours.

categories.intro: Бесшовные фоны для сайтов, презентаций, стримов, сцен; генеративное искусство.

items.title: Градиентный «живой» фон для сайта
items.prompt:
A 20-second seamless background loop for a website hero: soft mesh gradient of [COLOURS] slowly flowing, like lava lamp blobs, with subtle film grain.
Very calm motion, low contrast so text stays readable on top. Export as a small looping MP4 and a WebM.

items.title: Ретро-сетка (synthwave)
items.prompt:
A seamless synthwave loop: a neon pink perspective grid scrolls towards the viewer, a striped sun sets on the horizon, distant wireframe mountains, stars twinkling.
Magenta, purple, cyan; scanlines; seamless at 10 seconds.

items.title: Мяч в кольцах (физика)
items.prompt:
A satisfying physics clip: a ball bounces inside [N] concentric rotating rings, each with a gap. When the ball escapes a ring, the ring shatters into particles and a note plays (rising scale).
Ball grows slightly with each escape. Black background, rainbow rings, accurate collisions.

items.title: Генеративные потоки
items.prompt:
A 30-second generative art animation: thousands of thin lines follow a Perlin-noise flow field, leaving trails that slowly build an image of [SHAPE / ABSTRACT].
Palette: [PALETTE]. Seed it so the result is reproducible. Calm, meditative, gallery quality.

items.title: Космос/звёзды
items.prompt:
A slow seamless loop of drifting through deep space: layered nebula clouds in [COLOURS], parallax star fields, a faint galaxy rotating in the distance.
Extremely slow motion, cinematic, no planets or text. Perfect for a stream "starting soon" screen.

items.title: Экран «скоро начнём» для стрима
items.prompt:
A looping "Starting soon" screen for my stream [CHANNEL].
Center: "Starting soon" with a gentle breathing animation; below: a spinning [MASCOT / ICON].
Background: slow looping pattern in [COLOURS]. A space at the bottom for a chat overlay.

items.title: Изометрический мини-мир
items.prompt:
A tiny isometric diorama of [PLACE: a cozy island / a city block / a workshop] that loops: day turns to night and back, windows light up, a tiny car drives around, clouds pass.
Low-poly, soft pastel colours, gentle rotation of the whole scene. Seamless 15-second loop.

items.title: Жидкие формы (3D)
items.prompt:
Abstract 3D render: glossy iridescent liquid metal blobs merge and separate in zero gravity against a [COLOUR] background.
Soft studio lighting, reflections, slow motion, seamless loop feel. No text.

items.title: Бумажные слои (паралакс)
items.prompt:
A paper-cut landscape of [SCENE] built from 6 layered sheets with soft shadows between them; the layers sway slightly at different speeds (parallax), birds cross occasionally.
Colour palette: [COLOURS]. Seamless 12-second loop.

items.title: Анимированный узор (паттерн)
items.prompt:
A seamless tiling pattern animation: [SHAPES] rotate and swap places in a grid in a choreographed sequence, returning to the start.
Two colours: [COLOUR 1] / [COLOUR 2]. Precise, Bauhaus-inspired. 6-second loop.

items.title: Природа-луп для медитации
items.prompt:
A calm static shot of [SCENE: a forest stream / waves on a beach at dawn / a candle in a dark room / snow falling in a pine forest].
Only natural movement. Soft light. Steady tripod camera. Sound: natural ambience only.
Designed to loop; avoid any moving objects entering or leaving frame.

categories.intro: Готовые описания стиля. Допишите любой из них в конец любого шаблона, чтобы сменить внешний вид ролика без переписывания сюжета.

items.title: Плоская 2D-иллюстрация
items.prompt: Style: flat 2D vector illustration, 3–4 colour palette, no gradients, rounded shapes, thick consistent outlines, soft ease-in-out motion, subtle drop shadows.

items.title: Швейцарский / интернациональный
items.prompt: Style: International Typographic Style — strict grid, asymmetric layouts, Helvetica-like grotesque, black/white with one red accent, motion only along grid axes, hard snaps.

items.title: Бумага и коллаж
items.prompt: Style: handmade paper collage — torn edges, visible paper texture, cut-out photos, masking tape, stop-motion at 12 fps with slight jitter, warm natural light.

items.title: Пиксель-арт 16 бит
items.prompt: Style: 16-bit pixel art, limited 32-colour palette, nearest-neighbour scaling (no smoothing), stepped animation, chiptune-friendly pacing, CRT scanlines optional.

items.title: Глина (claymation)
items.prompt: Style: claymation stop-motion — plasticine characters with fingerprints, miniature handmade sets, 12 fps, warm practical lights, slightly imperfect movements.

items.title: Аниме / сёл-шейдинг
items.prompt: Style: hand-painted anime look, cel shading, soft painted backgrounds, dramatic sky, expressive eyes, wind-blown hair, warm golden light, gentle camera pans.

items.title: Неон и киберпанк
items.prompt: Style: neon cyberpunk — black background, magenta and cyan glow, chromatic aberration, scanlines, glitch transitions, synth-bass sound design.

items.title: Документальное кино
items.prompt: Style: documentary realism — natural light, handheld camera with subtle shake, 35mm lens, muted natural grade, real textures, ambient sound, no music.

items.title: Плёнка 35 мм
items.prompt: Style: shot on 35mm film, Kodak Portra colours, fine grain, soft halation around highlights, slight gate weave, anamorphic bokeh.

items.title: Минимализм Apple-стиля
items.prompt: Style: premium minimalism — lots of white space, one object at a time, soft studio shadows, large thin sans-serif type, slow precise easing, no more than two colours.

items.title: Мел на доске
items.prompt: Style: chalk on a dark green/slate board — hand-drawn strokes that draw themselves, chalk dust, slight wobble in lines, handwritten labels, yellow highlights.

items.title: Гравюра / линогравюра
items.prompt: Style: vintage engraving — crosshatched black ink lines on aged cream paper, ornamental frames, Victorian serif type, lines draw themselves before moving.

items.title: Акварель / книжка с картинками
items.prompt: Style: children's picture book — soft watercolour washes, pencil outlines, paper grain, pastel colours, page-turn transitions, gentle and slow.

items.title: Изометрия low-poly
items.prompt: Style: isometric low-poly 3D — orthographic camera at 30°, flat-shaded faces, pastel palette, soft ambient occlusion, toy-like scale.

items.title: Брутализм / громкий
items.prompt: Style: brutalist and loud — raw black/white/acid-green, oversized condensed type that overflows the frame, hard cuts on every beat, no easing, deliberate roughness.

items.title: Чертёж (blueprint)
items.prompt: Style: technical blueprint — white thin lines on deep blue, dimension arrows, monospaced labels, grid paper, lines draw before parts move, isometric views.

categories.intro: Формат из роликов вида «Claude рисует кодом»: одни и те же герои путешествуют по стилям, и каждую сцену Claude рисует программой (Three.js, SVG, canvas, ASCII, p5.js), без генератора картинок. Работает прямо в чате Claude (артефакт), в Claude Code или в Claude Motion. Сначала зафиксируйте героев шаблоном «Карточка героев», потом подставляйте `[HEROES]` в любой стиль.

items.title: Карточка героев (делать первой)
items.prompt:
Define two characters as a reusable spec I will paste into every scene, so they look the same in every style:
[HERO]: [e.g. a girl with long wavy ginger hair, freckles, big dark eyes, black hoodie with white drawstrings, black trousers, white sneakers].
[SIDEKICK]: [e.g. "Claude" — a terracotta-orange box with four short square legs, two small ears on the sides, two vertical black rectangle eyes and a small mouth].
Write: proportions (head-to-body ratio), exact colour HEX codes for every part, silhouette notes, 3 typical poses and 3 expressions.
Then draw both as a simple SVG turnaround (front, side, 3/4) so I can check them.

items.title: Ролик «путешествие по стилям»
items.prompt:
Make a 75-second vertical video where [HEROES] travel through [N, e.g. 8] visual styles, each drawn entirely in code.
Every scene is 6–10 seconds: the style changes with a quick transition (glitch, pixel dissolve, paper wipe), the characters stay recognisable.
Each scene has one line of dialogue as a subtitle (top third, white with an orange key word) where they comment on the new style in a funny way.
Styles in order: [STYLE 1], [STYLE 2], … (take descriptions from this file).
Ending: they try to go back to the first style, but it comes back "almost the same" with a small glitch — punchline.
Last 5 seconds: end card "[CTA]".

items.title: Low-poly 3D (Three.js)
items.prompt:
Draw [HEROES] as a low-poly 3D scene in Three.js: a cosy living room at dusk — wooden floor, sofa, round rug, tall window with orange curtains and city lights outside, a plant.
Characters built from simple primitives (boxes, spheres, cylinders) with flat shading and soft shadows; [SIDEKICK] wags an ear and bounces, [HERO] waves.
Warm key light from a lamp, cool fill from the window, slow orbiting camera. Render as an animated canvas, 1080×1920.

items.title: Плоский SVG (видно кривые)
items.prompt:
Draw [HEROES] as flat SVG illustration: muted teal wall, mustard armchair, a plant, an oval rug with dots, subtle paper grain.
Then, in the middle of the animation, briefly show the "construction view": bezier handles, anchor points and bounding boxes appear over the shapes, then fade away.
Animate with CSS/SMIL only: blinking, a small hop, the plant swaying.

items.title: Пиксельная игра (играбельная)
items.prompt:
Make a tiny playable pixel-art game in one HTML canvas: [HERO] runs and jumps around a cosy pixel room at night (lamp, bookshelf, sofa, window with city and moon), collecting coffee cups; [SIDEKICK] follows her.
16-bit look, 32-colour palette, no smoothing, 3 hearts and "SCORE 000" in a pixel font at the top.
Arrow keys / tap to play. Also add an "attract mode" that plays itself so I can record it.

items.title: Пиксельный портрет
items.prompt:
Draw a close-up pixel-art portrait of [HERO] on a 48×48 grid, scaled up crisply: framed like a game character select screen, blue background, white border.
Big sparkly eyes, freckles as single pixels, hoodie drawstrings visible.
Animate: blink every 2 seconds and a surprised open-mouth expression on cue.

items.title: ASCII-арт в терминале
items.prompt:
Draw [HEROES] entirely in ASCII characters inside a fake terminal window ("user@room:~$ cat room.txt").
Use dense characters (@#%*) for dark areas and light ones (.:-) for highlights; colour the characters (orange for [SIDEKICK] and hair, white for skin, dim green for the room).
Animate: the art prints line by line, then the characters blink; at one point [HERO] duplicates into three copies (copy-paste joke).
CRT look: dark green glow, scanlines, slight curvature.

items.title: Японская гравюра (укиё-э)
items.prompt:
Draw [HEROES] as a Japanese woodblock print (ukiyo-e) in SVG: a snowy mountain, stylised waves with foam claws, a red sun, a pine branch, flat sky gradient, aged paper texture.
A vertical cartouche with the title "[TITLE]" and a small red seal.
Limited palette: Prussian blue, indigo, red, beige. Gentle motion: waves curl, birds drift.

items.title: Мультик 1930-х (резиновые руки)
items.prompt:
Draw [HEROES] in 1930s rubber-hose cartoon style: black-and-white with grey tones, big "pie-cut" eyes, white gloves, bendy limbs, everything (even the furniture and the sun in the window) bouncing to the same rhythm.
Add film grain, flicker, slight jitter and a vignette.

items.title: Синтвейв / 80-е
items.prompt:
Put [HEROES] on a synthwave stage: neon magenta perspective grid scrolling to the horizon, striped setting sun, purple sky.
Characters get a neon rim light; floating lines of code drift past them like holograms.
Transition in: the previous scene "glitches" into the grid with an orange electric arc.

items.title: Кубизм
items.prompt:
Redraw [HEROES] in Cubism: faces split into flat geometric planes seen from several angles at once (both eyes on one side, nose in profile), ochre-brown-grey palette, overlapping translucent shards in the background (a cup, a guitar, a window).
Shapes slide slightly as if the viewpoint keeps shifting. Visible brush texture.

items.title: Герои из строк кода
items.prompt:
Render [HEROES] where every pixel is a character of the very code that draws them: dark editor background with faint scrolling source, the characters formed by coloured monospace text (orange for hair and [SIDEKICK], pale for skin, dark for the hoodie).
Count the lines of code that draw each character and show the number as a caption ("[HERO]: [N] lines, freckles: [N]").
Zoom in until single characters of code are readable, then zoom out.

items.title: Поп-арт комикс
items.prompt:
Draw [HEROES] as a pop-art comic panel: bold black outlines, Ben-Day halftone dots, flat primary colours, a jagged "WOW!" burst and a speech balloon "[LINE]".
Panel borders slam in one by one; the dots pulse slightly.

items.title: Конструктор из кубиков (воксели)
items.prompt:
Build [HEROES] from voxels / toy bricks in Three.js: each block falls from above and snaps into place with a tiny bounce until the characters are complete, then they wave.
Plastic shading with glossy highlights, studs on top, bright toy colours, studio floor.

items.title: Витраж
items.prompt:
Draw [HEROES] as a stained-glass window in SVG: thick dark lead lines, translucent jewel-tone glass pieces, a gothic arch frame.
Animate sunlight sweeping across so the glass colours glow and cast coloured light on a stone floor below.

items.title: Акварель (SVG-фильтры)
items.prompt:
Paint [HEROES] in watercolour using SVG filters (turbulence + displacement for bleeding edges, paper texture, pigment pooling at edges).
Washes appear one by one as if being painted, then pencil outlines draw on top. Soft pastel palette, lots of white paper.

items.title: Ван Гог (мазки по потоку)
items.prompt:
Paint [HEROES] at night under a swirling starry sky with thousands of short thick brush strokes that follow a flow field (p5.js).
Strokes in the sky keep swirling slowly; the characters are painted with strokes along their forms. Deep blues, yellow stars, visible impasto texture.

items.title: Бумажная вырезка / коллаж Матисса
items.prompt:
Make [HEROES] from cut-paper shapes in the style of Matisse cut-outs: bold flat colours, organic leaf and seaweed shapes floating around, slightly uneven scissor edges, soft shadows between layers.
Shapes flutter in and assemble the characters.

items.title: Чертёж (blueprint)
items.prompt:
Draw [HEROES] as a technical blueprint: white thin lines on deep blue grid paper, dimension arrows ("height: 1 cube"), part labels ("ear, left"), an exploded view of [SIDEKICK] showing how it is assembled.
Lines draw themselves before the characters move.

items.title: Светодиодная матрица / табло
items.prompt:
Show [HEROES] on a big LED dot-matrix sign: round glowing dots with bloom, limited 8-colour palette, the image scrolls in from the right like a stadium board, then a scrolling message "[TEXT]".
Slight dot flicker and dark gaps between LEDs.

items.title: Эмодзи-мозаика
items.prompt:
Build [HEROES] as a mosaic made only of emoji (🟧 for the cube, 🦰-like orange tones for hair, ⬛ for the hoodie, etc.) on a grid.
Animate: emoji pop in randomly until the picture is complete, then a few swap to make the characters blink and smile.

items.title: Оригами
items.prompt:
Fold [HEROES] as origami in Three.js: flat paper squares fold along crease lines step by step into the characters, with paper shading and visible creases.
Soft daylight, white table, finish with [SIDEKICK] hopping like a paper frog.
